ambiguities.text: The specification states 'None' for security considerations despite discussing DoS mitigation
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume security benefits are implied by the design rationale. DoS mitigation is a feature, not a residual risk being documented.

ambiguities.text: Transaction types are packed as a 'byte array' to align with early implementations
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this refers to encoding as bytes rather than RLP list for backwards compatibility with existing implementations.

implicit_assumptions.description: Peers provide accurate type and size information in announcements
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Lying about size could cause nodes to request unexpectedly large transactions, though actual data transfer still requires consent

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes implement reasonable throttling policies based on the metadata
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Without proper throttling implementation, eth/68 metadata provides no protection against bandwidth exhaustion

implicit_assumptions.description: All eth/68 nodes upgrade simultaneously or maintain backwards compatibility
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Mixed networks with eth/67 and eth/68 nodes may have inconsistent transaction propagation behavior
